scope: Dependency declarations in the frozen State.eq Dockerfile, the reviewed dependency-lock origin image, and the lock-v1 candidate verification boundary

verified_image.role: dependency-lock origin and independently full-reviewed pre-lock wrapper
verified_image.note: The local content-addressed image ID is not evidence that the image has been published under a registry digest. Its review evidence authenticates the captured dependency state; it does not review a newly built lock-v1 candidate wrapper.

candidate_wrapper.publication_status: not eligible until this exact candidate image ID has its own successful full offline review evidence

resolved_state_lock.build_verification: after frozen source image build and before lock-v1 candidate wrapper build

classifications.immutable_content_pin: The build verifies a cryptographic content identity or full source object before use.
classifications.explicit_version_pin: The declaration selects an exact version, but repository state or downloaded bytes can still drift.
classifications.transitively_immutable_in_base: The bytes are contained in the verified immutable base image, although rebuilding that base is outside this scaffold.
classifications.transitively_immutable_in_verified_image: The installed bytes are fixed by the reviewed dependency-lock origin image identity, but are not fixed inputs to a fresh networked rebuild.
classifications.fail_closed_resolved_state_lock: The exact resolved name/version state is captured and checked after build and at review startup; repository inputs are not yet locally archived.
classifications.fail_closed_installed_state_lock: The selected installed filesystem contents, metadata, and ownership are hashed and checked after build and at review startup; source archives are not yet locally archived.
classifications.observed_only: The version was read from the reviewed dependency-lock origin image but is not required by the frozen build declaration.
classifications.unfixed_resolution: The frozen build declaration does not select an immutable snapshot or exact package version.

immutable_pins.enforcement: validate_source.py followed by git archive of the exact commit
manifest validation, exact git checkout, image environment check, and runtime baseline check
build-image.sh verifies RepoDigests for the tag and then builds with --pull=false

immutable_pins.component: Ubuntu rootfs and packages already in the Pluto base
immutable_pins.identity: contained in the verified Pluto base image digest

version_pins.gap: The frozen Dockerfile downloads the versioned asset with --no-check-certificate. The captured dependency state lock verifies the checksum after build, not before execution.
The compiler package is selected from an unpinned opam repository state.
opam pin selects the version but the frozen build does not import a frozen repository snapshot or full switch export.

opam.installed_switch_state_note: The full export, exact package closure, and 40,269-entry switch filesystem tree are checked after every source image build and again at offline review startup. The frozen Dockerfile does not import the export during resolution.

apt.installed_package_state_note: The complete 684-package installed closure and 57,228-entry dpkg/package-owned filesystem tree are checked after every source image build and again at offline review startup. The frozen apt commands remain free to resolve unavailable or newer versions before this fail-closed check.
apt.declaration: apt-get install uses package names without =version constraints against focal, focal-updates, focal-backports, and focal-security

remaining_gaps: The lock-v1 candidate wrapper has not yet received its own full offline review evidence.
The full-reviewed dependency-lock origin image has not been published and therefore has no recorded registry digest.
Ubuntu repositories are moving endpoints rather than dated snapshots; exact observed deb versions are not enforced or archived.
The full dpkg closure and final installed file tree are verified, but exact deb files and repository metadata are not archived locally.
The opam repository state is not identified by a commit or snapshot and the full switch export is checked after resolution rather than imported before it.
The opam executable checksum is checked after build, while the frozen Dockerfile still disables certificate verification during the download.

A fresh networked build can fail because external packages disappear. The installed-tree hashes detect changed final contents, but only archived source or deb inputs can prevent different package code from executing before the post-build gate.
